sloka: महा गिरिम् इव अकंप्यम् महेन्द्र सदृशम् पतिम् ।महा उदधिम् इव अक्षोभ्यम् अहम् रामम् अनुव्रता ॥३-४७-३३॥
transliteration: mahā girim iva akaṁpyam mahendra sadṛśam patim ।mahā udadhim iva akṣobhyam aham rāmam anuvratā ॥3-47-33॥

translations.english: I am devoted to Rama, my husband, who is unshakeable like a huge mountain, is comparable to lord Indra and is imperturbable like the mighty ocean.
